---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for the app, backend, or pipeline
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're running into.

**What you'd like to see**

Describe the feature or change you have in mind.

**Where this applies**

- [ ] App (phone)
- [ ] App (e-ink / Boox)
- [ ] Backend / API
- [ ] Pipeline (listener, digest, or podcast scripts)
- [ ] Docs

**Alternatives considered**

Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems better.

**Anything else**

Mockups, links, or examples from other apps, if relevant. Remember the
maintainer reviews any visual change against a screenshot, so a mockup
helps a lot here.
